item.title: 🤖 Yolka rules the interception game On guard at our positions is the Yolka interceptor drone.
item.description: Yolka rules the interception game 🤖 On guard at our positions is the Yolka interceptor drone. This automated system detects, tracks down, and destroys enemy UAVs. ⚡️ Lightning ram: weighing just 1.3 kg, the vehicle accelerates to 230 km/h. The target is eliminated by kinetic impact: the drone slams into the enemy UAV at high speed and takes y out. 🧠 Digital intelligence : Yolka is equipped with artificial intelligence. The system analyses the target's design mid-flight and directs the strike at its most vulnerable point. 'The drone has proven itself very well. Everything works with artificial intelligence — it determines the target, the distance to them, and set the interception route,' the servicemen note. 🙌 Easy to handle: the system is easy to control — a short briefing is enough for troops to master it. #WeaponsZ 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

🚩
As a result of the resolute actions, the Tsentr Group of Forces liberated Veseloye in the Donetsk People's Republic.
💥
The losses were inflicted
on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one assault regiment of the AFU, and four national guard brigades near Belozerskoye, Novovodyanoye, Andreyevka, Verovka (Donetsk People's Republic), and Maryevka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 460 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, two artillery guns, and three electronic warfare stations.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one assault brigade, two air assault brigades, two assault regiments, one unmanned systems regiment of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Avramovka, Otrishki (Dnepropetrovsk region), Obshcheye, Vasinovka, Barvinovka, Omelnik, and Trudovoye (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 265 troops, an armoured fighting vehicle, eight motor vehicles, and one U.S.-made 155-mm M777 howitzer.
📍
The Dnepr Group of Forces' units took more advantageous lines and positions.
They inflicted damage on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade and one mountain assault brigade of the AFU close to Orekhov, Preobrazhenka, Kamyshevakha, and Yulyevka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
Up to 50 troops, 24 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, unmanned aerial vehicles, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage
on the logistics centres, fuel, power, and transport infrastructure of Ukraine, production facilities of unmanned aerial vehicles and unmanned ground vehicles, as well as temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed formations and foreign mercenaries in 155 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
seven guided aerial bombs and 670 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29352

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
⚡️
Units of the Sever Group of Forces in Kharkov region continue to tighten the enemy's encirclement
and expand the external control zone.
💥
Over the past 24 hours,
hostile manpower and hardware have been hit close to Novoaleksandrovka, Prikolotnoye, Malaya Volchya, and Buzovo, as well as blocked the enemy's formations near Olkhovatka (Kharkov region).
➡️
Russian troops thwarted two attempts by assault groups of the AFU to escape from the ring of encirclement
close to Sliznevo and Gogino in Kharkov region.
▪️
Up to 125 militants, four armoured fighting vehicles, three ATVs, and 12 UGVs were neutralised. Two Ukrainian servicemen surrendered.
🔥
In addition, strikes were delivered
at formations of one mechanised brigade, one motorised infantry brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade close to Shevchenkovo, Goptovka, and Lozovaya (Kharkov region).
💥
In Sumy region
, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade of the AFU and two territorial defence brigades close to Ulanovo, Velikaya Rybitsa, Khoten, Esman and Kiyanitsa.
▪️
In total, the enemy lost more than 215 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, and 17 motor vehicles in the Sever Group's area of responsibility.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
The Group's units hit formations of three mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade, one assault brigade of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade near Chervony Oskol, Grushevka, Senkovo (Kharkov region), Raygorodok, Krymki, and Prishib (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to more than 220 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 20 motor vehicles, and three field artillery guns, including one UK-made Braveheart self-propelled artillery system and one U.S.-made M114 howitzer.
📍
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, two motorised infantry brigades, one airmobile brigade, one mountain assault brigade of the AFU, and one marine brigade near Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Druzhkovka, Belenkoye, Nikolayevka, Vasilyevskaya Pustosh, and Orekhovatka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 180 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and 25 motor vehicles. Three field artillery guns, including one 155-mm Polish-made Krab self-propelled artillery system and one U.S.-made M777 howitzer, were neutralised.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry
